problem: The Phase 14-R scientific surface matrix was maintained manually and had no regression against the live capability and trusted-pack registries.

guarded_contract: active capability IDs exactly match matrix rows
every capability resolves to exactly one trusted pack
tool binding and result projector cells match the live manifest
all matrix coverage cells are non-empty and use an allowed status
every active result projector is registered

benefit: Registry, Pack and human coverage documentation now fail fast on capability drift instead of silently diverging.
